Mia Chen: Heads-up — I want to align infra/runtime/console on new GPU capacity metrics for Hosted + Dedicated pools. Goal: single dashboard + clear signals for autoscale/fallbacks. Who's available for a quick sync?

Samir Patel: +1, can we start by agreeing definitions? e.g., what exactly do we mean by SM occupancy here? percent of active warps per SM or kernel-SM time?

Alex Gomez: I'm worried about cardinality if we tag by model + tenant + host. Prefer aggregated signals per pool and optional tagged samples for drilldown.

Jia Park: For defs: propose SM_occupancy = time-weighted fraction of SMs with non-zero active wavefronts over a 1m window. Queue_depth = number of pending inference requests in GPU driver queue (+ scheduler queue). Memory: gpu_mem_total, gpu_mem_used, gpu_mem_reserved_by_scheduler.

Mia Chen: Nice. Jia — can you sketch the telemetry payload shape? small as possible, but enough to power the console and routing policies.

Jia Park: Sure — thinking JSON proto like:```json
{ "pool_id": "hosted-prod-a", "timestamp": 1670000000, "sm_occupancy_p50": 0.32, "sm_occupancy_p95": 0.78, "queue_depth": 14, "queue_depth_buckets": [0,10,20,50,100], "gpu_mem_total": 40_960, "gpu_mem_used": 28_400, "reserved_by_scheduler": 2048 }
```Keep sample rate 1s for headroom, ingest 1m aggregated for dashboards.

Alex Gomez: That looks OK. Two asks: 1) keep field names stable (no snake/camel mix), 2) add sample_count and sample_type so we can combine counters safely.

Samir Patel: Also — routing policy needs per-pool headroom metric: headroom = max(0, capacity_tokens_per_sec - sm_tokens_per_sec). We can compute tokens/sec from sm_occupancy and model token-rate hints. Can dashboard show both raw occupancy and derived headroom?

Luke Reynolds: From ops perspective we need alertable signals: sustained queue_depth > X for 3m, sm_occupancy_p95 > 0.9, memory_reserved > 90%. We should map those to runbook actions (scale up pool, fallback to cheaper model, throttle).

Mia Chen: Agreed. For Dedicated we must expose tenant-scoped metrics too (for billing/quota). We need to limit cardinality—maybe only emit tenant_id for Dedicated samples, not Hosted. Thoughts?

Alex Gomez: Tenant-only for dedicated makes sense. For Hosted, expose only pool and model_family. Also enforce sampling for model-level metrics (1/100 requests) to control cost.

Jia Park: Implementation note: runtime will emit raw per-GPU counters; we do local aggregation into 1s windows before sending. Telemetry team — what's the ingestion contract? @telemetry-bot any constraints?

telemetry-bot: telemetry ingestion: max 2000 events/s per customer stream; recommended payload <4KB; prefer delta counters for memory. Backpressure: 429 with Retry-After header. See /docs/telemetry/ingest-rate-limits

Samir Patel: Ok then we'll keep sample rate and size in check. One more API thing: should runtime push directly to telemetry or via internal metrics-proxy? Proxy lets us redact tenant ids for hosted.

Alex Gomez: Use metrics-proxy. It solves redaction + rate-limiting + enrichment (add pool mapping). Runtime teams should POST to /internal/metrics/v1/pool-samples. Proxy will forward to ingestion with transformed payloads.

Mia Chen: Good call. Action items: (1) Jia to draft proto + example payloads (by EOD tomorrow). (2) Alex to produce proxy contract (fields + auth + redaction rules) — EOW. (3) Luke to write runbook triggers and alert thresholds (PR in ops repo) — next Tue. (4) Samir + product to pick rollout canary strategy for console: start with Hosted read-only dashboard, then enable Dedicated tenant views behind flag.

Jia Park: I'll put proto in a draft PR: /infra/telemetry/protos/gpu_pool.proto and add example ingestion pipeline.

Alex Gomez: I'll stub the proxy endpoint today: POST /internal/metrics/v1/pool-samples — auth: service token, header X-Proxy-Env, supports redaction param.

Luke Reynolds: Will start runbook draft. One UX ask: console should show recommended action per-alert (scale/burst/fallback) with a one-click runbook link. Keep it visible on pool page.

Mia Chen: Perfect. Let's meet tomorrow 9:30am to review proto + contract. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: +1, see you.

Alex Gomez: added to calendar.
